column1: # THE JOSTRACA COMPONENT PRIMITIVES, nom and translate
# (docs/design/JOSTRACA.0.md). The components are aontu functions whose
# node carries the Jostraca component name; `nom` spells one name in
# one style, and `translate` maps characters of a string.
# Every expectation was taken from the canonical port and is held to
# the Go port by this file.
# A BARE STRING CHILD IS A LINE, terminator included: it is what a
# template body line desugars to, and jostraca's `Content` writes no
# newline, so two of them would run together. An explicit `content()`
# is still a span, which `cmp-bare-string-mixed` holds.
# THE PROP SCHEMA (docs/design/UNITS-AND-TREES.1.md P3). Every prop each
# Jostraca component declares, and nothing else: the props are the whole
# contract with the engine that writes the files, so a typo was a
# silently dropped `indent`, `mode` or `exclude`. The lists are hand-kept
# from the exported prop types at jostraca v0.38.0, because aontu takes
# no dependency on jostraca in either direction.
